pages.text: Twilight Rich Soil boosts plants above and below it several times per random tick. The number of trials can be changed in config.$(br2)Till it with a hoe to get Twilight Rich Soil Farmland, which boosts crops when fully moist.
Alternatively, use Witchcraft Bone Meal on Uberous Soil to convert it into Twilight Rich Soil.$(br2)Like rich soil, it also converts Mushgloom and Fiddlehead above it into colonies.
